instructions: Create a fresh, individually authored Blender furniture asset for Room B Floor Cabinet. The parent room_floor_cabinet-v005 remains the incumbent; its recorded transfer diagnosis identifies simple repeated beam forms and synthetic repeated grain. Replace those forms with physically modeled joinery and fitted components, and vary wood UV phase and scale deterministically per object. Use distinct quarter-sawn oak, light oak, walnut, brass, iron, and steel PBR response as appropriate. Export only render geometry: do not alter the authoritative RoomDefinition, collisions, navigation, selection, interaction targets, activities, assignments, or simulation.
